                                   Project Narrative and Plans
     at 1641 West 47"^ Street / 4704 South Marshfield Avenue - (United Yards ReSub Lot 1)

Type-1 zoning map amendment application to rezone properly located at 1641 West 47''^ Street /
4704 South Marshfield Avenue (the "Property") from zoning classification Bl-3 to Cl-3.
Al.     In cooperation with the City of Chicago's fNVEST Soutli/Wcst Initiative, Celadon
Properties, LLC, an Illinois limited Hability company (the "Applicant"), proposes to develop a new
two-story commercial building with a ground-floor brewery and tavern, a second-floor meeting
and small events space, and a rooftop partial penthouse with an outdoor garden and patio that will
have additional space for seating. The Property qualifies as a transit served location ("TSL"); it is
approximately 450 feet west of the CTA bus line corridor roadway segment served by the Ashland
/ 9 and Ashlaiid Express / X9 bus routes, as listed in Table 17-10-0102-B. 1 .b of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance ("CZO").

        At this time, the Property spans the northem portion of four lots located on the southwest
comer of West 47"" Street and South Marshfield Avenue and consists partially of vacant lots and
an improved parking lot. The Applicant is the title owner of all the subject lots. The said four lots
are currently orientated north/south and facing 47"' Street. At the direction ofthe Department of
Planning and Development, the four lots will be reorientated east/west to face Marshfield Avenue.
The Applicant will also seek a resubdivision ("United Yards ReSub") to achieve the same, where
United Yards ResSub Lots 2 and 3 will be each redeveloped with a 3-flat residential building, and
Lot 4 will serve as required off-sile parking for Lots 2 and 3. This Property—United Yards ReSub
Lot 1, will have various commercial uses, including a locally owned brewery and tavern, for the
benefit of revitalizing the commercial corridors of 47"' Street and Ashland Avenue.

       The Applicant seeks a map amendment from Bl-3, Neighborhood Shopping Di.strict to C l -
3, Neighborhood Commercial District to permit the uses of a brewery, tavern, and event space and
to allow potential approval of a rooftop patio. I f the proposed map iimendment is approved.
Applicant will apply to the Zoning Board of Appeals to grant a special use to allow.the rooftop
outdoor patio, apply to the Department of Planning and Development for affirmation that the
number of parking .spaces confonns to the transit served location allowances of CZO Section 17-
10-0102-B, and give notice to the local aldernian and apply to the Zoning Administrator for an
administrative adjustment for the approved parking reduction under CZO Section 17-13-1003-EE.

        The relevant bulk/density analysis, discussion of parking ratios, and zoning relief sought
are discussed in Part A.2. of this project narrative.

A2.   The following are the relevant bulk and density calculations for the proposed development
compared to the allowed standards under the requested Cl-3 district regulations.

Current Land Use: The Property is partially an unimproved gravel lot and parking lot. It will be
resubdivided into a rectangularly-shaped parcel on the southwest comer of West 47th Street and

Land opposite the Property, on the north side of 47'^ Sireet, has been improved with commercial
buildings and a Walgreens at the opposite comer of West 47"' Street and Marshfield Avenue.

Proposed Land Use: 2-slory brewery, tavern, and event space commercial building with a
partially-covered roolitop and outdoor patio to be rezoned from zoning classification Bl-3,
Neighborhood Shopping District to Cl-3, Neighborhood Commercial District. Specifically, the
following uses are proposed under the requested Cl-3 district regulafions:
       1.   Brewery (CZO § I7-3-0207-UU.3): permitted as limited manufacturing (food)
       2.   Tavem (CZO § 17-3-0207-AA.3): permitted
       3.   Outdoor patio at rooftop (CZO § I7-3-0207-AA.4): special use *
       4.   Indoor Special Event with incidental liquor sales (CZO § 17-3-0207-BB.l): pemiitted
       5.   Small venues (1 - 149 occupancy) (CZO § 17-3-0207-BB.3): permitted
       6.   Banquet or Meeting Halls (CZO § 17-3-0207-BB.6): pennitted

            o   Proposed: 0 spaces **
